North Delta townhomes for sale: ground-level homes in strata buildings. The Fraser Valley Real Estate Board benchmark for townhomes in North Delta was $845,600 in September 2026 (-4.7% over a year). Before you offer, read the strata documents: the depreciation report, meeting minutes, bylaws and fees.
North Delta townhomes sold, November 2025 to October 2026

43 townhomes sold in North Delta with a median price of $805,000 (the middle half sold between $726,000 and $907,500), taking a median of 21 days to sell at 97.1% of the last list price; 7% sold above list. They had a median $493 per square foot, a median year built of 2009 and a median strata fee of $422 a month.

blocks.text: North Delta Townhomes: streets and boundaries

items.t: North Delta is one of the City of Delta's three communities, and its townhouse stock clusters in two pockets: Nordel, around 84 Avenue between 112 Street and 120 Street, and Sunstone, on Delsom Crescent and Delsom Way off Nordel Way.

blocks.text: North Delta Townhomes: the housing stock

items.t: Nordel west of 116 Street adds Delta Ridge at 11490 84 Avenue, Kaleido at 10735 84 Avenue and the Delta Gardens townhomes at 8447 115 Street, from the same index.
East of Scott Road, Sunridge Estates at 6712 Baker Road is the complex recorded for North Delta's Canterbury side in the index.

blocks.text: North Delta Townhomes: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: North Delta Recreation Centre at 11415 84 Avenue is the civic anchor of the Nordel pocket, two blocks from the Delsom Crescent complexes.
Sunstone Park at 10400 Delsom Crescent lists playgrounds, sport courts, trails and a viewpoint in the City park search, and hosts the City's Luminary Festival each September.
Seaquam Secondary at 11584 Lyon Road, an International Baccalaureate (IB) World School, serves Delta's Sunshine Hills edge, not the Nordel pocket.
The City is rebuilding 84 Avenue between Delsom Crescent and 112 Street, with sanitary work anticipated in 2026 and roadway construction in 2027.
No TransLink route runs on 84 Avenue itself in the current timetable: the pocket's stops are on 112 Street, on route 312.

blocks.text: North Delta Townhomes: development and new projects

items.t: 8498. STATUS: readings recommended in the April 28, 2025 Council report, read 2026-11-03.

11220 and 11230 83 Avenue, Hearth Architectural Inc.: four three-storey townhouse units on each lot, rezoning RS1 to RT62 under Bylaws No. 8494 and 8495, 2026. STATUS: listed for Council consideration on May 11, 2026, read 2026-11-03.

blocks.text: North Delta Townhomes: getting around

items.t: Route 312 links the Nordel pocket to SkyTrain: Scottsdale Exchange via Scott Road, 72 Avenue, 112 Street, 92A Avenue, 114 Street and 96 Avenue to Scott Road Station.
Route 316 runs the 116 Street corridor from Scottsdale to Surrey Central Station, the closest bus spine for the Baker Road stock.

blocks.text: North Delta Townhomes: risks and due diligence

items.t: Start with the 30 m streamside line: ditches count under the Streamside Protection and Enhancement Development Permit Area guide, and Sunstone streets drain to open ditches.
For older complexes near 92 Avenue, ask about wind-up discussions: the 11944 92 Avenue proposal shows the City will entertain redevelopment of a 34-unit townhouse site.
